items.long_description:
The AI Essay Writer That Actually Reads the Research

Most AI writing tools generate citations from memory. That means fake DOIs, misquoted authors, and papers that don't exist — the kind of thing professors catch immediately.

Truessay works differently. Before writing a single word, it queries over 200 million peer-reviewed academic papers from Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex. Only then does it synthesize your essay — grounded entirely in sources that are real, verifiable, and citable.

How It Works

Truessay runs a 5-stage pipeline on every essay request:

Analyze — Decomposes your topic into targeted search queries using Gemini Flash
Search — Queries 200M+ papers across Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex simultaneously
Outline — Structures the argument around the actual sources found
Synthesize — Streams the essay in real time, citing only papers retrieved in step 2

The result: a fully structured research essay where every [1], [2], [3] maps to a real paper with a real DOI.

Key Features

Zero hallucinated citations — Sources are fetched before the essay is written, not invented after
200M+ paper database — Covers science, humanities, social science, medicine, engineering, and more
5 citation styles — APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE — formatted automatically
11 languages — Write in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Portuguese, Arabic, Italian
Real-time streaming — Watch your essay appear word by word, typically in 30–90 seconds
Export-ready — Output in Markdown, with Word and LaTeX compatibility

Who It's For

Students struggling with the blank page — get a properly cited first draft in under 2 minutes, then refine it in your own voice.

Researchers who need fast literature synthesis — use it to map the academic landscape on a new topic before diving deeper.

International students writing in a second language — full multilingual support means you can work in your native language while producing academically rigorous output.

Why It Beats the Alternatives

| | Truessay | ChatGPT | Jenni AI | Caktus AI |
|--|---------|---------|----------|-----------|
